params.name: currentStep
params.description: Current step, clamped between 1 and the normalized total. Overall progress includes subSegmentProgress / 100 and is capped at totalSteps. Page text is generated from these values.

params.name: totalSteps
params.description: The number of steps and segments, rounded to an integer with a minimum of 1.

params.name: subSegmentProgress
params.description: Additional progress as a percentage of one step, clamped between 0 and 100. Adds subSegmentProgress / 100 to the current step. Defaults to 0; the overall value is capped at completion and determines both fill and ARIA.

params.name: label
params.description: Optional text shown on the left of the header and used as the accessible name after trimming whitespace. Missing or blank labels use Progress as the accessible name, matching React.

params.name: helperText
params.description: Optional supporting text below the track. Read separately from the progress bar by assistive technology.

params.name: showBars
params.description: Whether to show gaps between segments. Defaults to true. Set to false for a continuous track without gaps.

params.name: classes
params.description: Additional CSS classes for the outer element, merged with ofh-progress-indicator.

params.name: attributes
params.description: Additional HTML attributes, such as id or data attributes, for the outer element.
